sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS
(FOURTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 11th October, 2001]
No.S.LEGIS:1/(32)2001, dated
11-10-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Local Government
Elections (Fourth Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 20th September, 2001.

Substitution of section 18-A of Sindh Ordinance No. X of 2000

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS
(FOURTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXII OF
2001
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 11th October, 2001]
No.S.LEGIS:1/(32)2001, dated
11-10-2001. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Substitution of section
18-A of Sindh Ordinance No. X of 2000.- In the Sindh Local Government
Elections Ordinance, 2000, for section 18-A, the following shall be
substituted:--
"18-A. Election to
vacant, seats.--(1) If a seat of a member remains unfilled or becomes
vacant during the term of office of Council, a new member shall be elected
through bye-election and the member elected in by election shall hold office
for the remaining portion of the term of the Council.
(2) If any seat reserved for
women remains vacant, the same shall be filled through bye-elections and the
elected women member shall hold office for the remaining portion of the term of
the Council.
(3) All bye-elections shall be
held once a year on a date or dates fixed by the Chief Election Commissioner.
(4) A vacancy of Union Nazim or
Naib Union Nazim shall be filled through bye-election within sixty days of the
occurrence of vacancy.
(5) A vacancy of Zila Nazim, Naib
Zila Nazim, Taluka Nazim or Town Nazim, Taluka Naib Nazim or Town Naib Nazim
shall be filled through bye-election within thirty days of the occurrence of
vacancy.
(6) When the office of a Zila
Nazim or Naib Zila Nazim, Taluka Nazim, or Town Nazim, Naib Taluka Nazim or
Naib Town Nazim, Union Nazim or Naib Union Nazim remains unfilled or falls
vacant, the members of the concerned Council shall by a majority vote elect an
officiating Nazim or Naib Nazim as the case may be from amongst its members and
the person so elected shall continue to retain his office as a member also:
Provided that the officiating
Nazim or Naib Nazim shall not be a candidate in the bye-election held for
election of the Nazim or Naib Nazim respectively.".
